name: vending-pharmacy
description: 55-inch Touchscreen 24/7 Pharmacy Vending Kiosk (Node.js & Vanilla JS 3D Canvas)

scripts.test: node -e "const { buildFrame, parseFrame, PROTOCOL } = require('./backend/protocol.js'); const f = buildFrame(PROTOCOL.TYPE.COMMAND, PROTOCOL.CMD.SET_OUTPUT, 1, [1, 1]); if (f.toString('hex').toUpperCase() !== 'AA010401020101F972') { console.error('Mismatch:', f.toString('hex')); process.exit(1); } const p = parseFrame(f); if (!p || p.cmd !== PROTOCOL.CMD.SET_OUTPUT) process.exit(1); console.log('Protocol Test Passed: AA010401020101F972');"
